## Reusable rules

1. **Keep flattened job fields and their documentation in sync** When intentionally removing an `inputs` wrapper, update documentation paths that refer to it and reflect the flattened fields in the resource model. *Scope:* Job-generation APIs whose design intentionally flattens the inputs envelope; preserve other APIs’ intended shapes. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/40dfdf30c1cd83e4822882b639a8496a1a8b99f8/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/evaluators/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46955

2. **Make the create body explicit when separating job inputs from the resource** For this flattened job pattern, the patch replaces `postJob` with an explicit input body and created-resource response while the resource uses `JobLike<..., never>`. Treat this as a pattern for that design, not a blanket rule for all jobs. *Scope:* Job-creation APIs that intentionally separate submitted generation inputs from persisted resource fields; other `JobLike` input types may be appropriate. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/40dfdf30c1cd83e4822882b639a8496a1a8b99f8/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/evaluators/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/40dfdf30c1cd83e4822882b639a8496a1a8b99f8/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/evaluators/routes.tsp
